sources.locator: PDF page 428, rows 24-46; checked against extracted layout text and a rendered page image
sources.collection_name: Records of the Office of Strategic Services, Record Group 226
sources.rights_notes: All 23 printed rows remain preserved. Protected identifiers are retained only in the private database and are masked from public data.

sources.title: Electronic Army Serial Number Merged File, ca. 1938-1946
sources.author_creator: Department of Defense; Department of the Army
sources.locator: Official unrestricted bulk file ASNEF.FIN.DAT; seven exact name-and-identifier matches reviewed
sources.collection_name: Records of the National Archives and Records Administration, Record Group 64
sources.rights_notes: Full identifiers, raw rows, Army entry-grade codes and occupation codes are not published. Army-coded fields are not treated as named employers or OSS ranks.

sources.title: Rep. Lynch Presents OSS Congressional Gold Medal To U.S. Army Private Semeon ‘Sam’ Simollari
sources.author_creator: Office of U.S. Representative Stephen F. Lynch
sources.locator: Press release paragraphs identifying Simollari as a U.S. Army private, describing his Army enlistment and explicit OSS recruitment, and documenting his Albanian-unit radio service
sources.rights_notes: Only the explicit Army-to-OSS sequence and wartime role are retained. The page's postwar foreign-car business is excluded from pre-OSS employment fields.

sources.title: Interments—15th Infantry—ABMC
sources.locator: PDF page 12, James U. Simmons entry; exact protected identifier, Technical Sergeant rank, California entry, 23 December 1944 death, Epinal burial and Purple Heart reviewed
sources.collection_name: 15th Infantry interments compiled from American Battle Monuments Commission data
sources.rights_notes: The protected identifier is used only for private identity resolution and is not reproduced in public project data. The conventional unit context is not inferred to be an immediate pre-OSS affiliation.

sources.title: Simms, Pvt. Clarence E.
sources.locator: Biographical opening and reproduced War Department notice; the namesake's service identifier differs from the indexed person's protected identifier
sources.rights_notes: Retained only as a rejected identity lead. The article's Booster Produce Company employment cannot be transferred to the indexed Clarence E. Simms.

sources.title: Peace Now Movement Collected Records
sources.locator: Biographical/Historical note identifying a Bessie Simon as executive secretary and formerly associated with the America First Committee
sources.rights_notes: Retained only as a rejected identity lead. No protected identifier, OSS assignment or Box 713 personnel-file link establishes that this is the indexed Bessie Simon.

organizations.normalization_notes: Existing canonical organization reused for the explicit Army-to-OSS sequence; no narrower pre-recruitment unit is invented.

affiliations.end_date: before recruitment by OSS during World War II
affiliations.date_precision: The congressional history gives an explicit Army-enlistment-to-OSS-recruitment sequence but no exact recruitment date.
affiliations.research_notes: The official congressional history states that Simollari enlisted in the U.S. Army and was recruited there by OSS for his Albanian language and cultural knowledge. It later describes his radio duties in the Albanian OSS unit. No pre-Army civilian employer is identified.

claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes wartime identity; the congressional source explicitly orders Army enlistment before OSS recruitment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed James U Simmons is a high-confidence match to Technical Sergeant James U. Simmons in the 15th Infantry ABMC-derived interment register.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact full name and protected identifier agree; the register adds Technical Sergeant rank, California entry, wartime death, Epinal burial and Purple Heart.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact name and a matching protected identifier in a regiment association register compiled from ABMC data.
claims.temporal_assessment: The register establishes wartime Army identity and death on 23 December 1944, but it does not establish the sequence between conventional Army service and OSS.
claims.match_notes: The 15th Infantry context is not labeled an immediate pre-OSS affiliation because the accessible sources do not establish that chronology.

claims.claim_text: Semeon ‘Sam’ Simollari enlisted in the United States Army and was recruited from the Army by OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The congressional history explicitly states that Simollari enlisted in the Army and was recruited there by OSS for his Albanian language and cultural knowledge.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed identity from the exact uncommon name, nonshared protected identifier and official Army-to-OSS narrative.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicit immediate sequence; the exact recruitment date and pre-recruitment Army unit are not supplied.
claims.match_notes: This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer. Simollari's postwar foreign-car business is excluded, and his last civilian employer before Army service remains unresolved.

claims.claim_text: The Clarence Edward Simms profiled by the Bataan Project is rejected as the indexed Clarence E Simms.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Bataan biography reproduces a service identifier different from the protected identifier printed for the indexed person.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The names agree, but the conflicting unique identifiers establish that the biography cannot be assigned to this index row.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Bataan biography includes pre-Army employment, but that evidence belongs to the rejected namesake and is not transferred.
claims.match_notes: The indexed person instead has a separate exact-name and identifier match in the official Army bulk file.

claims.claim_text: The Peace Now Movement executive secretary Bessie Simon is not accepted as the Bessie Simon indexed in Box 713.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The finding aid documents a historically relevant Bessie Simon but supplies no identifier, OSS assignment or personnel-file reference connecting her to the index row.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Name-only agreement is insufficient for this incomplete index entry.
claims.temporal_assessment: The documented Peace Now and America First affiliations are pre-OSS-era leads, but their relation to the indexed person is unestablished.
claims.match_notes: The lead remains available for future archival comparison but is not published as this person's employment or affiliation.
